blocking: The tree does not preserve an open middle: oversized branches and fruit intrude behind the statement and pillar cards.
Repeated thin gold card outlines and grid dividers contradict the no-grid-hairlines direction.
Service copy offers sofreh styling, signage and favour boxes, crossing the prohibition on decor content.
Pomegranate placeholder photographs substitute for wedding imagery throughout the celebrations, leaving the premium service visually unsubstantiated.

fixes.what: Constrain trunks and branches to separate outer-edge regions; keep the entire statement and pillar area free of painted art. Lower the desktop hero canopy so its central foliage stays within the bottom quarter.
fixes.why: The tree should frame the experience; its current scale crowds the content and overwhelms the wedding footage.

fixes.where: weddings.html — tradition copy; how-we-work.html — What you get and Thank-you
fixes.what: Remove offers to design or lay an architectural sofreh, supply signs, style seasonal tables and provide favour boxes. Describe ceremony scheduling, family communication and vendor coordination instead; apply the same correction to homepage teasers.
fixes.why: These tangible styling deliverables breach the explicit service-scope restriction.

fixes.what: Replace fruit placeholders with permission-cleared photographs of the actual named ceremonies. Match each caption to the photograph; reserve fruit studies for About Anar.
fixes.why: Repeated fruit imagery makes the wedding offering feel conceptual rather than established.

fixes.what: Remove decorative perimeter borders and repeated grid rules. Separate content through spacing and restrained background changes; retain input boundaries and a deliberate standalone kashida.
fixes.why: The current boxed layout reads as a generic interface rather than a premium editorial brand.

fixes.what: Shorten pillar headings to 'Fluent in your traditions', 'Heritage, with your vision' and 'Every day, coordinated'. Remove statement all-caps and tracking, reduce it to two concise sentences, and move the full founder letter to About. Keep TT Ramillas Bold.
fixes.why: The second pillar wraps into seven lines, while oversized repeated declarations make the page dense and monotonous.

fixes.what: Make How we work an inline secondary link instead of a persistent gold overlay. Remove the logo blur tween and use a restrained fade as the hero exits.
fixes.why: The floating control competes with Inquire and covers the artwork; blurring the primary mark weakens its deliberate, premium presentation.
